questions.question: Which state special schools have the highest number of enrollees from grades 1 through 12?
questions.evidence: State Special Schools refers to DOC = 31; Grades 1 through 12 means K-12
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.School FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.DOC = 31 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Among the schools with an SAT excellence rate of over 0.3, what is the highest eligible free rate for students aged 5-17?
questions.evidence: Excellence rate = NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr; Eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 = `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
questions.SQL: SELECT MAX(CAST(T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE CAST(T2.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T2.NumTstTakr > 0.3

questions.question: What is the average number of test takers from Fresno schools that opened between 1/1/1980 and 12/31/1980?
questions.evidence: between 1/1/1980 and 12/31/1980 means the year = 1980
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' AND T2.County = 'Fresno'

questions.question: What is the Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) in the school administered by an administrator whose first name is Alusine. List the district code of the school.
questions.evidence: Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) = `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` * 100%
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`, T1.`District Code` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'

questions.question: Rank schools by their average score in Writing where the score is greater than 499, showing their charter numbers.
questions.evidence: Valid charter number means the number is not null
questions.SQL: SELECT CharterNum, AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM schools AS T1  INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T2.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND CharterNum is not null

questions.question: Among the sets in the block "Ice Age", how many of them have an Italian translation?
questions.evidence: sets in the block "Ice Age" refers to block = 'Ice Age'; Italian translation refers to language = 'Italian' and translation is not null
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T1.block = 'Ice Age' AND T2.language = 'Italian' AND T2.translation IS NOT NULL

questions.question: Which foreign language used by "A Pedra Fellwar"?
questions.evidence: "A Pedra Fellwar" refers to name = 'A Pedra Fellwar'
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT language FROM foreign_data WHERE name = 'A Pedra Fellwar'

questions.question: Which are the cards that have incredibly powerful foils.
questions.evidence: incredibly poweful foils refers to cardKingdomFoilId is not null AND cardKingdomId is not null
questions.SQL: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL

questions.question: What proportion of cards do not have a text box with a normal layout?
questions.evidence: do not have a text box refers to isTextless = 1; proportion refers to DIVIDE(COUNT(Textless = 1 and layout = 'normal'),COUNT(Textless))*100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 1 AND layout = 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM cards

questions.question: What is the percentage of the cards with a converted mana cost of 7 in the set Coldsnap?
questions.evidence: converted mana cost of 7 refers to convertedManaCost = 7; card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(convertedManaCost = 7), SUM(convertedManaCost))*100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.convertedManaCost = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap'

questions.question: Among the cards with converted mana cost higher than 5 in the set Coldsnap, how many of them have unknown power?
questions.evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'; converted mana cost higher than 5 refers to convertedManaCost > 5; unknown power refers to power = '*' or T1.power is null
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.power = '*' OR T1.power IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.convertedManaCost > 5

questions.question: Indicates the number of cards with pre-modern format, ruling text "This is a triggered mana ability." that do not have multiple faces.
questions.evidence: pre-modern format refers to format = 'premodern' ;do not have multiple faces refers to side IS NULL
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid INNER JOIN rulings AS T3 ON T1.uuid = T3.uuid WHERE T2.format = 'premodern' AND T3.text = 'This is a triggered mana ability.' AND T1.Side IS NULL

questions.question: Which of the play format has the highest number of banned status? Indicate the play format and the names of all the card meet the condition.
questions.evidence: play format refers to format; banned status refers to status = 'Banned'; the highest number of banned status refers to MAX(COUNT(status = 'Banned'))
questions.SQL: WITH MaxBanned AS (SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS count_banned FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned' GROUP BY format ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT T2.format, T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN MaxBanned MB ON MB.format = T2.format WHERE T2.status = 'Banned'

questions.question: For the customer who paid 634.8 in 2012/8/25, what was the consumption decrease rate from Year 2012 to 2013?
questions.evidence: '2012/8/24' can be represented by '2012-08-24'; Consumption decrease rate = (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(Date, 1, 4) = '2012', Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(Date, 1, 4) = '2013', Consumption, 0)) AS FLOAT) / SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(Date, 1, 4) = '2012', Consumption, 0)) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = ( SELECT T1.CustomerID FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25' AND T1.Price  = 1513.12 )

questions.question: What's the nationality of the customer who spent 548.4 in 2012/8/24?
questions.evidence: '2012/8/24' can be represented by '2012-08-24'
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.Country FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Price  = 548.4

questions.question: What is the amount spent by customer "38508" at the gas stations? How much had the customer spent in January 2012?
questions.evidence: January 2012 refers to the Date value = '201201'
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(T1.Price ) , SUM(IIF(T3.Date = '201201', T1.Price, 0)) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID WHERE T1.CustomerID = '38508'

questions.question: What is the percentage of the customers who used EUR in 2012/8/25?
questions.evidence: '2012/8/25' can be represented by '2012-08-25'
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25'

questions.question: For all the people who paid more than 29.00 per unit of product id No.5. Give their consumption status in the August of 2012.
questions.evidence: August of 2012 refers to the Date value = '201208' ; Price per unit of product = Price / Amount;
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.Consumption FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Price / T1.Amount > 29.00 AND T1.ProductID = 5 AND T2.Date = '201208'

questions.question: In the branch where the second-highest number of crimes were committed in 1995 occurred, how many male clients are there?
questions.evidence: Male refers to gender = 'M'; A15 stands for no. of commited crimes 1995
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M' AND T2.A15 = (SELECT T3.A15 FROM district AS T3 ORDER BY T3.A15 DESC LIMIT 1, 1)

questions.question: How often does account number 3 request an account statement to be released? What was the aim of debiting 3539 in total?
questions.evidence: k_symbol refers to the purpose of payments
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.frequency, T2.k_symbol FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id, k_symbol, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id, k_symbol) AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T1.account_id = 3 AND T2.total_amount = 3539

questions.question: What is the percentage of loan amount that has been fully paid with no issue.
questions.evidence: Loan paid with no issue means contract finished, no problems; status = 'A' means contract finished, no problems; Percentage of accounts by condition = [(total(amount) & condition) / (total amount)] * 100%
questions.SQL: SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100) / SUM(amount) FROM loan

questions.question: List out the account numbers of clients who are youngest and have highest average salary?
questions.evidence: If the person A's birthdate < B's birthdate, it means that person B is younger than person A; A11 refers to average salary
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.account_id  FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id INNER JOIN district AS T4 on T4.district_id = T1.district_id WHERE T2.client_id = ( SELECT client_id FROM client ORDER BY birth_date DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY T4.A11, T1.account_id

questions.question: From Year 1995 to 2000, who are the accounts holders from 'east Bohemia'. State the account ID the frequency of statement issuance.
questions.evidence: Accounts holder refers to the person who own this account.
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.account_id, T1.frequency FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T2.A3 = 'east Bohemia' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) BETWEEN '1995' AND '2000'

questions.question: What is the average of fastest lap speed in the 2009 Spanish Grand Prix race?
questions.evidence: Spanish Grand Prix is the name of race refers to name = 'Spanish Grand Prix'; average fastest lap speed refers to avg(fastestLapSpeed);
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(T1.fastestLapSpeed) FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 on T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T2.year = 2009 AND T2.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix'

questions.question: Which driver ranked the first in the Canadian Grand Prix in 2007? Please give his reference name.
questions.evidence: reference name refers to driverRef; Canadian Grand Prix refers to races.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix';
questions.SQL: SELECT T3.forename, T3.surname, T3.driverRef FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND T2.rank = 1 AND T1.year = 2007

questions.question: What is his number of the driver who finished 0:01:54 in the Q3 of qualifying race No.903?
questions.evidence: race number refers to raceId; finished 0:0M:SS in the Q3 refers to q3 LIKE 'M:SS%'
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.number FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 903 AND T1.q3 LIKE '1:54%'

questions.question: Where is Malaysian Grand Prix held? Give the location coordinates.
questions.evidence: location coordinates refers to (lat, lng); Malaysian Grand Prix refers to races.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'

questions.question: How old is the youngest Japanese driver? What is his name?
questions.evidence: date of birth refers to drivers.dob; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa; Japanese refers to nationality = 'Japanese'; age = YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(dob);
questions.SQL: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', dob), forename , surname FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Japanese' ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: On what year did the youngest driver had his first qualifying race? Also state the name, date and time of the race.
questions.evidence: date of birth refers to drivers.dob; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa; first qualifying race refers to MIN(races.date);
questions.SQL: SELECT T3.year, T3.name, T3.date, T3.time FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 on T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 on T1.raceId = T3.raceId WHERE T1.driverId = ( SELECT driverId FROM drivers ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY T3.date ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which country is the oldest driver from?
questions.evidence: date of birth refers to drivers.dob; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa;
questions.SQL: SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show me the season page of year when the race No. 901 took place.
questions.evidence: the season page refers to url; race number refers to raceId;
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.url FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN seasons AS T2 ON T2.year = T1.year WHERE T1.raceId = 901

questions.question: What is the best lap time recorded? List the driver and race with such recorded lap time.
questions.evidence: the best lap time refers to min(milliseconds); List the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname; List the race refers to races.name
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.milliseconds, T1.forename, T1.surname, T3.name FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN lapTimes AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId ORDER BY T2.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was Lewis Hamilton's final rank in the 2008 Chinese Grand Prix?
questions.evidence: Lewis Hamilton refers to the full name of the driver; Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname; final rank refers to positionOrder; Chinese Grand Prix refers to races.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix';
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.positionOrder FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T3.forename = 'Lewis' AND T3.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T1.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND T1.year = 2008

questions.question: What are the budget category of the events located at MU 215 and a guest speaker type with a 0 budget spent?
questions.evidence: budget category refers to category; events located at refers to location; type = 'Guest Speaker'; 0 budget spent refers to spent = 0;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.category, T1.type FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.location = 'MU 215' AND T2.spent = 0 AND T1.type = 'Guest Speaker'

questions.question: Name the event with the highest amount spent on advertisement.
questions.evidence: Name of event refers to event_name; highest amount spent on advertisement refers to MAX(spent) where category = 'Advertisement'
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.event_name FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T1.category = 'Advertisement' ORDER BY T1.spent DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Among the events attended by more than 10 members of the Student_Club, how many of them are meetings?
questions.evidence: meetings events refers to type = 'Meeting'; attended by more than 10 members refers to COUNT(event_id) > 10
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.event_id) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.type = 'Meeting' GROUP BY T1.event_id HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_event) > 10

questions.question: Tell the phone number of "Carlo Jacobs".
questions.evidence: Carlo Jacobs is the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name;
questions.SQL: SELECT phone FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Carlo' AND last_name = 'Jacobs'

questions.question: Indicate the cost of posters for 'September Speaker' event.
questions.evidence: 'Posters' is the expense description; 'September Speaker' is an event name
questions.SQL: SELECT T3.cost FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T1.event_name = 'September Speaker' AND T3.expense_description = 'Posters'

questions.question: What is the amount of the funds that the Vice President received?
questions.evidence: 'Vice President' is a position of Student Club; funds received refers to amount.
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.amount FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.position = 'Vice President'

questions.question: List the name of students that have attended more than 7 events.
questions.evidence: name of students means the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name; attended more than 7 events refers to COUNT(link_to_event) > 7
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member GROUP BY T2.link_to_member HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_event) > 7

questions.question: Calculate the average height for all superhero.
questions.evidence: average = DIVIDE(SUM(height_cm), COUNT(all heros));
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(height_cm) AS REAL) / COUNT(id) FROM superhero

questions.question: What are the names of the superheroes with the power of death touch?
questions.evidence: name of superheroes refers to refers to superhero_name; the power of death touch refers to power_name = 'Death Touch'
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Death Touch'

questions.question: Provide the eye colour of the superhero who has Karen Beecher-Duncan as their full name.
questions.evidence: eye colour refers to colour.colour where eye_colour_id = colour.id; Karen Beecher-Duncan is the full name of superhero;
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.colour FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan'

questions.question: How many gold-eyed superheroes did Marvel Comics publish?
questions.evidence: gold-eyed refers to colour = 'Gold' where eye_colour_id = colour.id; superheroes that Marvel Comics published refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND T3.colour = 'Gold'

questions.question: Describe the names of neutral alignment superheroes.
questions.evidence: names of superheroes refers to superhero_name; neutral alignment refers to alignment = 'Neutral';
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id WHERE T2.alignment = 'Neutral'

questions.question: Which superheroes have blue eyes with brown hair?
questions.evidence: which superheroes refers to superhero_name; blue eyes refers to color = 'Blue' and color.id = eye_colour_id; brown hair refers to color = 'Brown' and color.id = hair_colour_id;
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.hair_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue' AND T3.colour = 'Brown'

questions.question: Rank heroes published by Marvel Comics by their height in descending order.
questions.evidence: name refers to superhero_name; the tallest hero refers to MAX(height_cm); published by Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
questions.SQL: SELECT superhero_name, height_cm, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS HeightRank FROM superhero INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

questions.question: How many powers does Amazo hero have?
questions.evidence: Amazo hero refers to superhero_name = 'Amazo';
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.power_id) FROM hero_power AS T1 INNER JOIN superhero AS T2 ON T1.hero_id = T2.id WHERE T2.superhero_name = 'Amazo'

questions.question: What is the ratio of outpatient to inpatient followed up treatment among all the 'SLE' diagnosed patient?
questions.evidence: 'SLE' diagnosed patient means Diagnosis = 'SLE'; inpatient refers to Admission = '+'; outpatient refers to Admission = '-'; calculation =  DIVIDE(COUNT(ID) where Diagnosis = 'SLE' and Admission = '+', COUNT(ID) where Diagnosis = 'SLE' and Admission = '-')
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'

questions.question: How old was the patient who had the highest hemoglobin count at the time of the examination, and what is the doctor's diagnosis?
questions.evidence: How old the patient refers to SUBTRACT(year(`Examination Date`), year(Birthday)); the highest hemoglobin count refers to MAX(HGB)
questions.SQL: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday), T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID ORDER BY T2.HGB DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Among the patients who have an abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase, when was the youngest of them born?
questions.evidence: abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase refers to GOT > = 60; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa;
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60 ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: For patients with abnormal platelet level, state the number of patients with lower than normal range. How is it compare to the number of patients with higher than normal range?
questions.evidence: abnormal platelet level refers to PLT <= 100 or PLT >= 400; platelet level lower than normal range refers to PLT < 100; calculation = SUBTRACT(SUM(PLT < 100), SUM(PLT > 400)); platelet level higher than normal range refers to PLT > 400;
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PLT <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PLT >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

questions.question: List and group all patients by sex for total bilirubin (T-BIL) level not within the normal range.
questions.evidence: List refers to GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ID); total bilirubin (T-BIL) not within normal range refers to T-BIL > = 2.0
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.ID,T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 GROUP BY T1.SEX,T1.ID

questions.question: How many patients with an Ig G higher than normal?
questions.evidence: Ig G higher than normal refers to IGG >= 2000; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG >= 2000

questions.question: For laboratory examinations take in 1984, list all patients below 50 years old with normal platelet level.
questions.evidence: laboratory examinations take in 1984 refers to YEAR(Date) = '1984'; below 50 years old = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)) < 50; normal platelet level refers to PLT between 100 and 400;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 50 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984'

questions.question: What are the bonds that have phosphorus and nitrogen as their atom elements?
questions.evidence: have phosphorus as atom elements refers to element = 'p'; have nitrogen as atom elements refers to element = 'n'
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.bond_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_id IN ( SELECT T3.bond_id FROM connected AS T3 INNER JOIN atom AS T4 ON T3.atom_id = T4.atom_id WHERE T4.element = 'p' ) AND T1.element = 'n'

questions.question: What type of bond is there between the atoms TR004_8 and TR004_20?
questions.evidence: type of bond refers to bond_type; between the atoms TR004_8 and TR004_20 refers to atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND atom_id2 = 'TR004_20' OR another way around
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.bond_type FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20' OR T2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR004_20'

questions.question: Please list top three elements of the toxicology of the molecule TR000 in alphabetical order.
questions.evidence: TR000 is the molecule id;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY T.element LIMIT 3

questions.question: List all the elements of the toxicology of the molecule "TR004".
questions.evidence: TR004 is the molecule id;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR004'

questions.question: What is the percentage of carcinogenic molecules in triple type bonds?
questions.evidence: label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; triple bond refers to bond_type = '#'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(bond_type = '#') * 100, COUNT(bond_id)) as percent where label = '+'
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#'

questions.question: What are the elements of the atoms of TR144_8_19?
questions.evidence: TR144_8_19 is the bond id;
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.element FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19'
